_note: Engine-owned scoring rules. They are applied ON TOP of the KB scoring config so the validated KB files stay byte-identical. All numeric values are engineering starting parameters, configurable, and NOT clinically validated (spec section 17).

overall_bands._spec: Section 2 / 18. Overall evidence score decides Balanced / Not assessed properly / Imbalanced and the severity label.

diminishing_returns._spec: Sections 8 / 18. Applied to independent evidence groups ordered strongest to weakest, AFTER semantic/correlation grouping.
diminishing_returns._curve_note: Section 8 states a stepped curve (1, .75, .5, .25, .25-floor) while its own formula and sections 17/18 state 0.70^(n-1). Section 18 'Final Recommended Parameter Set' is used as the default; set curve to 'stepped' to switch. Both are unvalidated starting points.

aggregation._spec: Section 3: new = old + (1 - old) * contribution (overall). Section 8: directional support = c1*m1 + c2*m2 + ...

direction._conflict_margin: Removed (section 10). Dominance ratio is the single direction-conflict rule.

gates_not_used: winning directional score >= 0.45 AND confidence >= 60% AND >= 2 independent units (section 11: not re-approved)
firm (full-reliability) evidence requirement for a direction (not in the finalized spec)
